mapper.sql: payments.id, payments.public_id AS publicId, payments.table_session_id AS tableSessionId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, payments.amount, payments.bill_snapshot AS billSnapshot, payments.status, payments.confirmed_by_name AS confirmedByName, payments.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, payments.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payments INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=payments.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id WHERE payments.table_session_id=#{sessionId}

SELECT FROM payments INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=payments.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND payments.public_id=#{publicId}

SELECT FROM payments INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=payments.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND payments.status='PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unpaid_records WHERE unpaid_records.table_session_id=payments.table_session_id) ORDER BY payments.created_at ASC

SELECT FROM payments INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=payments.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND payments.status='PAID' AND payments.confirmed_at >= #{confirmedAtStart} AND payments.confirmed_at < #{confirmedAtEnd} ORDER BY payments.confirmed_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=payments.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND payments.status='PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unpaid_records WHERE unpaid_records.table_session_id=payments.table_session_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status='PAID',confirmed_by=#{accountId},confirmed_by_name=#{name},confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE payments SET amount=#{amount},bill_snapshot=#{snapshot} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE unpaid_records SET amount=#{amount},bill_snapshot=#{snapshot} WHERE table_session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unpaid_records WHERE table_session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='OPEN')
mapper.update: UPDATE unpaid_records SET status='RESOLVED',resolution_payment_id=#{paymentId},resolved_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE table_session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT unpaid_records.public_id AS publicId, table_sessions.public_id AS tableSessionId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, unpaid_records.amount, unpaid_records.bill_snapshot AS billSnapshot, unpaid_records.status, unpaid_records.reason, unpaid_records.reported_by_name AS reportedByName, payments.public_id AS paymentId, unpaid_records.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, unpaid_records.created_at AS createdAt FROM unpaid_records INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=unpaid_records.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id INNER JOIN payments ON payments.table_session_id=table_sessions.id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND unpaid_records.status=#{status} ORDER BY unpaid_records.created_at DESC

SELECT unpaid_records.public_id AS publicId, table_sessions.public_id AS tableSessionId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, unpaid_records.amount, unpaid_records.bill_snapshot AS billSnapshot, unpaid_records.status, unpaid_records.reason, unpaid_records.reported_by_name AS reportedByName, payments.public_id AS paymentId, unpaid_records.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, unpaid_records.created_at AS createdAt FROM unpaid_records INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=unpaid_records.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id INNER JOIN payments ON payments.table_session_id=table_sessions.id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND unpaid_records.public_id=#{publicId}

SELECT table_sessions.id AS sessionId, table_sessions.public_id AS sessionPublicId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, table_sessions.status AS sessionStatus, payments.public_id AS paymentPublicId, table_sessions.created_at AS openedAt FROM table_sessions INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id LEFT JOIN payments ON payments.table_session_id=table_sessions.id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND table_sessions.status IN ('OPEN','PAYMENT_PENDING') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, table_sessions.created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) >= #{minimumOpenMinutes} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE orders.table_session_id=table_sessions.id) ORDER BY table_sessions.created_at ASC
